name: Samsung Galaxy S10 / S20 / S21

charge_control.note: The switch most often reported to work on Galaxy S10/S20/S21 (ACC project). Stops charging; on most kernels it also cuts USB input power, so the phone runs from the battery until charging resumes.
Only on some Snapdragon variants. Uncertain: verify.
One UI 'Protect battery' cap in percent: a cap below the current charge pauses charging. Some kernels accept only fixed values (85 or 100) or make it read-only. Uncertain: verify.
Retail demo mode: pauses charging only above about 70% and resumes near 60%, so it cannot stop charging lower down. Last resort.

autoboot.note: Samsung has no fastboot, so 'fastboot oem off-mode-charge' does not exist. Needs a root change that makes the charging-only mode (LPM) reboot into Android, for example an auto-boot Magisk module or boot-image patch; on older models, replacing the charging-animation program. Support varies by model: make it the first Phase 0 test (plan Appendix A.2).

notes: Matches SM-G97x (S10e, S10, S10+, S10 5G), SM-G98x (S20, S20+, S20 Ultra) and SM-G99x (S21, S21+, S21 Ultra, and the S21 FE SM-G990x).

Buying (plan Appendix A.1): models ending in U, U1 or W (USA, Canada) cannot be bootloader-unlocked. The software must be One UI 7 (Android 15) or older: One UI 8 removed unlocking. The S21 FE received One UI 8, so check it was never updated.
Unlocking and rooting use Download mode and Odin, not fastboot. Unlocking wipes the phone and trips Knox permanently.

Galaxy S10 family (launched with Android 9): the boot image has no ramdisk, so Magisk is installed to the recovery partition and root is only active when the phone boots through recovery. A cold power-on after a power cut starts without root. Prove 'Root survives a reboot' and automatic power-on together on an S10, or prefer an S20/S21 (launched with Android 10/11, Magisk in the boot image).
current_now: Samsung's battery driver reports milliamps, positive while charging. Confirm with tools/phase0/phase0.sh current-sign.
Use 'Protect battery' (85%, or 80 to 95% on One UI 7) as the base charge limit; the root switch above takes it down to 50-60% (plan 4.2).
One UI stops background apps aggressively: set the Agent to Unrestricted battery use and add it to 'Never sleeping apps' (the hsm-keepalive module also whitelists it from Doze).
Dial *#0011# for the service menu (band and signal) to cross-check the Signal Finder.
Once Android runs, a USB-C hub with HDMI and a mouse can stand in for a dead screen; Download mode does not output video.
Keep automatic updates off: an update to One UI 8 was reported to re-lock unlocked phones.
